note: Candidate classes only. Every class is unverified. Recording and training refuse any class with verified set to false. The official ISLRTC English Alphabet chart is the source of truth. The owner-supplied chart is a provisional visual reference. A qualified ISL signer must confirm each handshape before a class can be verified.

class_schema.label: The letter used as the class name
class_schema.hands: 1 or 2, matching the handshape on the reference chart
class_schema.meaning: What the sign means in the reference
class_schema.reference: Source id from sources plus the page or cell used
class_schema.verified: true only after a check against the reference
class_schema.signer_confirmed: true only after a Deaf ISL signer or qualified ISL interpreter confirms the handshape
class_schema.category: alphabet or numbers. Decides which Learn Signs section shows the class.
class_schema.reference_folders: Folders relative to the static gestures folder, one per image set and variant.

sources.name: English Alphabets in Indian Sign Language, ISLRTC chart (developed by ISLRTC, DEPwD, MoSJE)
sources.checked: PDF downloaded and read on 2026-11-08 (page 1 of 1). Letter shapes read from the chart image.
sources.notes: Official ISLRTC chart. It shows each letter as a still drawing. Hand counts were judged from the drawings, so they need signer confirmation.

sources.name: ISL Dictionary, ISLRTC
sources.checked: Not read directly. Dictionary entries are videos.
sources.notes: Use for word-level signs in a later phase.

sources.name: ISL Dictionary based on Universal Design of Learning (200 words), NCERT and ISLRTC
sources.checked: Not fetched. The URL failed to download.
sources.notes: Candidate source for word-level classes in a later phase.

sources.name: Indian Sign Language, National Institute of Open Schooling
sources.notes: States that ISL fingerspelling is two-handed in the common form, and that ISL is not a manual form of English.

sources.name: Diploma in Teaching Indian Sign Language (DTISL) curriculum, Rehabilitation Council of India
sources.notes: Lists the English manual alphabet as two-handed for basic communication and one-handed for deaf-blind learners.

sources.name: Alphabet and number chart supplied by the project owner (provenance not confirmed)
sources.checked: Viewed as an image on 2026-11-11. Not confirmed as the official ISLRTC chart.
sources.notes: Provisional visual reference only. The convention is not confirmed as ISL, and the chart resembles a common ASL-style fingerspelling chart. J and Z are drawn with motion arrows. Do not verify any class from this source alone. Use ISLRTC-ALPHABET as the source of truth.

sources.name: Static gestures of Indian Sign Language (ISL) for English Alphabet, Hindi Vowels and Numerals (owner-supplied image sets)
sources.checked: Folder structure inspected 2026-11-15. Individual images were not reviewed.
sources.notes: Six image sets: Kids, Teenagers and Adults, each with full and half sleeves. Used as reference images for training. A mapping is not approved until the project owner reviews it.
